name: Análisis de Mapa de Iluminación
description: Detecta inconsistent iluminación sources a través de image regions by estimating local color temperature maps.
algorithm: Physics-Based Illuminant Estimation for Forgery Detection
mechanism: Estima el color del iluminante local usando cromaticidad de intensidad inversa y algoritmos de mundo gris generalizado. Las regiones empalmadas con diferente iluminación muestran estimaciones inconsistentes del iluminante.
parameters: Estimation: IIC + GGW, Superpixel: SLIC (k=200), Distance: angular, Clustering: k-means
source: Riess, C. & Angelopoulou, E. (2010) — Scene Illumination as an Indicator of Image Manipulation, IEEE WIFS
useCase: Detecting spliced regions by identifying inconsistent lighting conditions dentro de a single image

references.title: Riess, C. & Angelopoulou, E. (2010) — Scene Illumination as an Indicator of Image Manipulation, IEEE WIFS

strengths:
• Physics-based approach
• Detecta cross-image empalme
• Visualizable as color map
• Complementary to other methods
limitations:
• Assumes single illuminant per region
• Fails on complex multi-light scenes
• Requires sufficient color varianza
• Sensitive to specular highlights
